doc: The emote vocabulary — names, clips, icons, bar order. This table used to live in FOUR places (avatar.js EMOTES + EMOTE_ORDER, emotebar's ICON map, the /emote help string — which listed dance twice — and the help sheet's prose), inconsistently. One place now: key order IS the bar/number-key order; `clip` names the animation the roster serves; `icon` is the bar's glyph; `listed: false` keeps an emote dispatchable by /emote but off the bar and number keys (same flag doctrine as the command registry).
